BJP National Team Holds First Meeting Under New Chief Nitin Nabin

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) national president Nitin Nabin chaired the first meeting of the party's newly reshuffled 65-member national team. Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with the team, praising their "new ideas and perspectives." The meeting focused on preparations for the 2027 state elections and the 2029 general elections. The reshuffle includes a push towards engaging younger members, with figures like Nitin Nabin, Smriti Irani, and Vinod Tawde selected for nationwide outreach.
